marker.description: No specific marker (pin, arrow, or tag) is present to indicate a specific anatomical feature on the bone.

main_question: Identify the bone indicated by the green paint.
main_explanation: The bone is the fibula, a long bone of the lower leg. It is identified by its slender shaft, the small head at the proximal end, and the distinct lateral malleolus at the distal end.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures articulates with the head of the fibula?
supporting_question.explanation: The head of the fibula articulates with the lateral condyle of the tibia at the proximal tibiofibular joint.

true_false.statement: The fibula bears the majority of the weight of the body during standing.
true_false.explanation: The tibia is the weight-bearing bone of the lower leg, while the fibula serves primarily as a site for muscle attachment and provides lateral stability.
